description: Boruta, the devil nobleman of Polish legends, a devil dressed as a Polish nobleman in a long green kontusz coat over a red zupan, a wide gold and red sash at the waist, a curved sabre in his hand, a fur kolpak cap with a white heron feather plume, small horns poking out from under the cap, a curled black moustache and a sly grin, glowing red eyes, one leg in a red boot and one goat hoof, menacing, standing, full body, three-quarter view, the creature alone, no rocks, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture
